stopPoints.label: Good morning
stopPoints.question:
Question (Greeting): 'Who says Good morning to Peppa and George?'
Guidance: 'It is Daddy Pig!'

stopPoints.label: Looking at nature
stopPoints.question:
Question (Listening): 'What is Daddy Pig going to look at today?'
Guidance: 'He wants to look at nature!'

stopPoints.label: Nature program
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'What animal is on the TV?'
Guidance: 'It is a bird! Can you tweet like a bird?'

stopPoints.label: Loud bird
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Is the bird quiet?'
Options: 'A) Yes, it is. B) No, it is loud.'
Guidance: 'No, it is loud! They can\'t hear the TV.'

stopPoints.label: Going out
stopPoints.question:
Question (Comprehension): 'Are they going to watch TV all day?'
Guidance: 'No! They are going outside to have fun!'

stopPoints.label: Tree World
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'What can you see in Tree World?'
Guidance: 'You can see a big forest full of trees!'

stopPoints.label: Potato City
stopPoints.question:
Question (Vocabulary): 'What food do they have in Potato City?'
Guidance: 'They have potatoes!'

stopPoints.label: Duckland
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'What animal lives in Duckland?'
Guidance: 'Ducks live there! Quack quack!'

stopPoints.label: Choosing Duckland
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Do Peppa and George love ducks?'
Guidance: 'Yes, they do! Let\'s go to Duckland!'

stopPoints.label: Asking the way
stopPoints.question:
Question (Listening): 'Listen! Who is talking and showing them the way?'
Guidance: 'The camper van is talking!'

stopPoints.label: Buying tickets
stopPoints.question:
Question (Counting): 'How many tickets did Daddy Pig ask for?'
Guidance: 'Two adults and two children. That makes four tickets!'

stopPoints.label: Time for a picnic
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'What are they going to do on the grass?'
Guidance: 'They are going to have a picnic lunch!'

stopPoints.label: The ducks arrive
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'Who came to their picnic?'
Guidance: 'The ducks came!'

stopPoints.label: More ducks
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Is there only one duck?'
Guidance: 'No, there are lots of brothers and sisters!'

stopPoints.label: Picnic gone
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'Oh no! Who ate all the picnic food?'
Guidance: 'The ducks ate it all!'

stopPoints.label: Saying thank you
stopPoints.question:
Question (Manners): 'What did Daddy Pig say to the ducks?'
Guidance: 'He said: You\'re most welcome!'

stopPoints.label: Driving into the river
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'Where does the camper van want them to drive?'
Guidance: 'Into the river!'

stopPoints.label: Turned into a boat
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'Wow! What did the camper van turn into?'
Guidance: 'It turned into a boat!'

stopPoints.label: Meeting friends
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'Who is driving the other boat?'
Guidance: 'It is Granddad Dog and Danny Dog!'

stopPoints.label: Back home
stopPoints.question:
Question (Emotion): 'Are they happy to be back home?'
Guidance: 'Yes! It is nice to be back in their own little house.'
